client.industry_primary: Automotive aftermarket parts and accessories e-commerce
client.business_model: Online retailer and distributor of aftermarket automotive parts with two U.S. distribution centers servicing enthusiasts worldwide
client.client_history: Founded in 1985 by Jay Zeigler and Creed Stammel, CJ Pony Parts began as a Mustang restoration parts supplier and has grown into a leading e-commerce platform offering 100,000+ SKUs for multiple vehicle models. The company operates distribution hubs in Pennsylvania and Nevada and received a majority investment from Century Park Capital Partners in April 2021 to accelerate its growth.

revenue.notes: Public estimates vary widely: Buzzfile $24.6M, Growjo $27.7M, Zippia $55M, Grips Intelligence $72.3M (online sales only). No official figures available; using midpoint (Zippia) but confidence is low.

locations.source: Company address information in multiple documents (e.g., PBM Consulting Agreement page 1) and ContactOut profile (https://contactout.com/company/cj-pony-parts-6047386)
locations.notes: Headquarters campus in Harrisburg, PA and a 100,000 sq ft distribution center in Las Vegas, NV confirmed by ContactOut and Lusha profiles.

employees.notes: Other sources: NAICSList 141, SignalHire 100-200, Buzzfile 56, Zippia 67. Selected Growjo figure as mid-range; lack of official disclosure lowers confidence.
